metrics_definition.retrieval_accuracy: Percentage of questions where at least one expected source PDF appeared in the final reranked chunks.
metrics_definition.answer_accuracy: Percentage of questions where the generated answer matched the expected answer or achieved at least 50% keyword coverage, with unanswerable questions counted according to refusal behavior.
metrics_definition.answerable_accuracy: Answer accuracy calculated only for questions marked answerable=true.
metrics_definition.refusal_accuracy: Percentage of unanswerable questions for which the assistant correctly refused.
metrics_definition.citation_accuracy: Percentage of answerable/source-backed questions where the expected PDF source appeared in the final retrieved metadata.
metrics_definition.overall_score: Mean of retrieval accuracy, answer accuracy, citation accuracy, and refusal accuracy when unanswerable questions are present.
